_description: TY2025 IRS standard deduction amounts by filing status. NRAs CANNOT claim the standard deduction unless they are a student/business apprentice from India claiming benefits under US-India Tax Treaty Article 21(2). All other NRA filers must use itemized deductions on Schedule A (1040-NR) or take $0 deduction. Source: IRS Rev. Proc. 2024-40 Section 3.13.

nra_rules._note: NRAs generally get $0 standard deduction. Exception: India treaty Article 21(2) allows student/business apprentice from India to claim the single-status standard deduction.

additional_amounts._note: Additional standard deduction for age 65+ or blind. Most NRA students are <65 and not blind; included for completeness.
